description: European football match results with statistics and betting odds from Football-Data.co.uk (free CSV data): for a league and season — date, kick-off, teams, full-time and half-time score, result, referee, shots, shots on target, corners, fouls, cards, plus market average and Bet365 1X2 odds and average over/under 2.5 odds. 20 leagues (Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Süper Lig…). Filter by team. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

league.description: League code: E0, E1, E2, E3, EC, SC0, SC1, D1, D2, I1, I2, SP1, SP2, F1, F2, N1, B1, P1, T1, G1 (E0 = Premier League)

season.description: Season start year, e.g. 2025 for 2025/26 (default: current season)

team.description: Only matches of this team (as spelled by the source, e.g. Man City)

name: dev_football_data_couk
title: Dev Football Data Couk
